name: std::atomic<T>::operator=
intro:
1,2) Atomically assigns desired to the atomic variable. Equivalent to store(desired).


It is deprecated if std::atomic<T>::is_always_lock_free is false and overload (2) participates in overload resolution.


(since C++20)

3,4) Atomic variables are not CopyAssignable.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: Unlike most assignment operators, the assignment operators for atomic types do not return a reference to their left-hand arguments. They return a copy of the stored value instead.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: A shared counter starts at 4, then receives 8, 10, and 12.
